Hymn 37: The Wintry Day, Descending to Its Close
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: Orson F. Whitney
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 37 titled "The Wintry Day, Descending to Its Close" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Orson F. Whitney.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
